definitions.explanation: The quality of being beautiful. The noun form of the adjective {美|うつく}しい, used for visual, natural, and abstract beauty alike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was struck by the beauty of the flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歌声|うたごえ}→歌声：20116_utagoe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{入|い}った。
examples.english: I listened intently, captivated by the beauty of her singing voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧きれないこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The beauty of nature sometimes cannot be fully conveyed in photographs.

notes:
The noun form of the i-adjective ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧ (beautiful), made with the {〜さ} suffix that turns adjectives into nouns naming the quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美|うつく}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧: be amazed at the beauty
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ: the beauty of nature
- {美|うつく}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: maintain beauty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧: beauty — a more abstract, formal noun (as in ⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追求|ついきゅう}→追求：14401_tsuikyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧); {美|うつく}しさ feels more concrete and felt
